newsitem.title: USA: Access Health wins 1 mln member contract.
newsitem.headline: Access Health wins 1 mln member contract.

text.p: Access Health Inc said Friday it has reached an agreement to provide health management service to one million members of Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida over the next 15 months.
Financial terms of the deal were undisclosed.
Access Health's stock jumped 4-9/16 to 47-3/8 in early morning trading.

Under the deal, Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida's health maintenance organization, called Health Options Inc, will offer begin offering Access Health's Personal Health Advisor, an information and counseling service.
Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida will initially offer the service to 220,000 Medicare supplement customers and 155,000 commercial managed care customers.
The rollout will first cover northeast Florida and begin on October 1, Access Health said in a statement.
Blue Cross and Blue Shield of Florida intends to expand the plan statewide throughout 1997 so that all its one million group members will have access by December, it said.
Personal Health Advisor, with over 10 million members in the United States, provides immediate, 24-hour-a-day medical information via phone, personal counseling and other means.
